title: Existing matrix ranges have no gaps or overlaps after the release
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Use the staging site, where the Tiered Pricing release is deployed on top of data from before the release.
  • Use a staging client with a matrix created before the release that has at least three ranges (matrix A).
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click matrix A's name.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Matrix A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Each range starts one cent above the end of the range before it ($100.00 + $0.01 = $100.01, for example $0.00–$100.00, then $100.01–$10,000.00).
  • No two ranges cover the same cost, and no cost between two ranges is missing.
